5.2.7 Wang Shing House (Block G)  
The investigation at Wang Shing House (Block G) was firstly conducted by SFn ████ WONG Kin-chi on 27.11.2025. During the inspection, the main power switch was firstly found at the “OFF” position and the indicator lamp not illuminated. When the main power switch was turned to the “ON” position by SFn WONG, the indicator lamp of the FS pump panel illuminated. The FAS was preliminarily tested by triggering the test switch but failed to work.

5.2.8 Wang Chi House (Block H)  
The investigation at Wang Chi House (Block H) was firstly conducted by StnO SHEK Ngai-chun on 26.11.2025. During the inspection, the main power switch was firstly found at the “OFF” position and the indicator lamp not illuminated. When the main power switch was turned to the “ON” position by StnO SHEK, the indicator lamp of the FS pump panel illuminated. The FAS was preliminarily tested by triggering the test switch but failed to work.
